notes: The official site settles the 2026 dates as 22 to 26 Jul. Barreltopia is the 2026 title sponsor. There is no IG account on the record (search only found unrelated accounts); the festival uses Facebook @salinaslongboardfestival. RTPA reported the 20th edition (2022) was suspended over safety deficiencies. The organiser is still unconfirmed: the site footer only says Salinas Longboard Festival.
